questions.stem: What is produced when ethanol is dehydrated?
questions.explanation: Dehydration of ethanol removes water (H2O) to produce ethene: C2H5OH -> C2H4 + H2O. This requires a hot aluminium oxide (Al2O3) catalyst or concentrated sulfuric acid. It is the reverse of the hydration reaction used to make ethanol from ethene.

questions.stem: What colour change is observed when ethanol is oxidised using acidified potassium dichromate(VI)?
questions.explanation: When ethanol is oxidised by acidified potassium dichromate(VI), the solution changes from orange to green. The orange Cr2O7 2- ions are reduced to green Cr3+ ions, while ethanol is oxidised to ethanoic acid: C2H5OH + 2[O] -> CH3COOH + H2O.
